description: Enable or disable DNSSEC for a zone. Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

status.description: Set 'active' to enable DNSSEC, 'disabled' to turn it off.

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: edit_dnssec
